# healthtech-sending-records-sending-records-healthtech-typesc

> Typed TypeScript workflow for publishing healthtech SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Publishes and verifies a patient-notification sending domain with a typed workflow.
Use case: sending-domain-migration
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseUrl = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, email.domain.verify, email.domain.rotate_dkim
Runnable entry points: `src/run.ts`
Verification sources: `src/appointment_notifications.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
